title: Wanting this, not that: The neural circuit that turns specific expectations into actions
content:
by Joey A. Charbonneau, Erin L. Rich

Neuroeconomics has long focused on reward values, ignoring their identity. A new PLOS Biology study shows that identity-specific reward expectations in the lateral orbitofrontal cortex steer goal-directed choices through a motivational circuit involving the nucleus accumbens.
